last_result_summary: 306a versus 303b/296c postmortem concluded that local one-step covariance is not enough. The missing mechanism is a persistent latent variable shared across the future path. This keeps the reset doctrine intact better than the hybrid frontier and is more principled than additional covariance or rollout knobs.
